The '''Fellwe sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located within the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]], near the [[Immalia sector/Legends|Immalia sector]]. It contained the [[Golden Nyss Shipyards]].

The [[House Benelex|Benelex Bounty Hunters Guild]] was active in this sector.<ref name="GG10" />
